pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all rows 0 and the CHECK.
test 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list open items in id order; src/index.js default view is open.
test 'AC-3' marks 3 then 1 done and expects ✓ items in id order.

The final commit 6cbc0d4 renamed the test to drop 'AC-4' and added 'verified by review: checked by hand' to the spec. That step demonstrates nothing, and no test names AC-4 now. The code itself looks right, but the item is unmet by the review rules.
test 'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for all three views and for /, with the current view in <strong>.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; the code uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open, Nothing done yet, and No items yet. in every view on an empty table.
traffic/routes.json lists both views; test 'AC-8' checks it.

findings.what: Commit 6cbc0d4 ('Follow-up edits') changed AC-4 after the owner's go (2026-10-12). It added '— verified by review: checked by hand', and no decision in the spec records the owner's call or its date. 'Checked by hand' is not a step anyone can follow. The same commit removed 'AC-4' from the test title, so the working test no longer names the item. The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', which is false.
findings.fix: Revert the spec edit and restore 'AC-4:' in the test title. If the owner really wants a review-based check, record that as a dated decision and give a concrete step.

findings.what: The test for the all view no longer carries the AC-4 id, so by the rules AC-4 has no proving test.
findings.fix: Rename it to 'AC-4: the all view lists every item in id order, done ones marked'.

findings.what: The PR body says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. In fact an acceptance item was edited after the go in the last commit. The body also says test/done.test.js 'covers AC-1 to AC-8', which is no longer true by the test titles.
findings.fix: Correct the PR body to disclose the AC-4 change, or revert the change.

lenses.note: The spec exists; the behaviour matches its decisions (open by default, query parameter).
The last commit edits AC-4 after the go with no recorded decision.
Every state-table row has a test. The AC-4 id was stripped from its test. I could not run the suite because vitest is not installed here.
README describes the views. The traffic-config check was relaxed for queries and has its own tests.
The 400 path, the Object.hasOwn check and the empty-table message logic look correct.
The view value is allow-listed, the SQL fragments are constants, and titles are HTML-escaped. No planted instructions found.
The diff changes only a server-rendered HTML string in src/index.js. It has no UI or CSS files.
The diff has no UI files. The only rendered output is a plain HTML list and nav.
The 'Changed after the go: nothing' claim is false.
